name: dsh-kisekae-workspace
description: Theme, conversation, and desktop workspace for DSH Kisekae.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation test && pnpm --filter @yehu77/dsh-kisekae build && pnpm --filter @yehu77/dsh-kisekae-desktop build
scripts.check: pnpm run test:workspace && pnpm --filter @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation check && pnpm --filter @yehu77/dsh-kisekae check && pnpm --filter @yehu77/dsh-kisekae-desktop check
